annotation_policy: Manual boxes identify development targets only. Never supply this file, its boxes, or target identities to proposal generation, tracking, motion, lane assignment, emission, or the label model.
box_convention: Original source-image pixels, [left, top, right, bottom), scaled to the verified working frame only during evaluation.
limitations: The two anchor frames are manually inspected development annotations, not exhaustive object labels or independent footage.
A/B edit checks cover masks geometrically associated at the declared anchor only; extra unmatched edits are reported for review rather than asserted correct.
Track identity across occlusion is a tracker limitation. A fragmented or ambiguous target fails evaluation rather than selecting a track by its classification or edit outcome.
Confidence remains a heuristic. This evaluation establishes neither metric road localization nor a calibrated confidence probability.
